de.abas.ceks.jedp.query

Class FieldRelatedEDPQueryDescriptor

  • Object
    • EDPQueryDescriptor
      • FieldRelatedEDPQueryDescriptor
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    EDPRequestCommandBuilder, FieldRelatedEDPRequestCommandBuilder, FieldListEnabledQuery, Serializable
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    DataQuery, EnumerationItemQuery

    public abstract class FieldRelatedEDPQueryDescriptor
extends EDPQueryDescriptor
implements FieldRelatedEDPRequestCommandBuilder
    Abstract base class for all queries which can be executed field related. This means, that in an editor the query can be related to an edit field and result may differ from the general result produced without a field relation.

    xg
